feedback.problem:
If
    $K=[\begin{aligned}a-b & 3c\end{aligned}]$,
then find the transpose of $K.$
  

| ${K}^{T}=$ |  | {{field-1}} |
| --- | --- | --- |
|  | {{field-2}} |  |
feedback.worked_solution:
To find the transpose, we interchange the rows and columns:

$$
{K}^{T}=[\begin{aligned}a-b \\ 3c\end{aligned}]
$$
